title: Termination Security Requirement and Amount Remitted - C&I Credit Standard
content:
**1. Requirement.** Under Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts, the termination security required on a terminating contract is its damages portion plus its supply portion, that sum reduced by the termination security's gas relationship relief, which is a share of that sum. No gas relationship relief applies to the termination security.

**2. Damages portion.** The damages portion of the termination security is the early termination fee billed on the contract, in full.

**3. Supply portion.** The supply portion of the termination security is its monthly supply rate multiplied by its exposure days, divided by 30 days per cycle.

**4. Monthly supply rate.** The monthly supply rate of the termination security is the net charges of the most recently posted billed cycle, meaning that cycle's supply lines (its energy, block energy, index energy, capacity and transmission charge lines) plus any rebill credit dated to that cycle. The most recently posted cycle is the cycle whose billing period start appears on the supply line with the latest posted date; a rebill credit is dated to the cycle of the line it corrects.

**5. Exposure days.** The exposure days of the termination security are the structure's termination notice days.

**6. Amount remitted.** The amount remitted is the requirement less the security deposits held on the contract (deposits posted less deposits refunded), rounded half up to the cent only at that last step; nothing is remitted when the deposits held already cover the requirement.

Nothing in clauses 1 to 5 is rounded; only the amount remitted is.

## Worked through (hypothetical figures)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| early termination fee billed on the contract | $18640.25 |
| latest posted cycle: energy charge line | $41212.48 |
| latest posted cycle: capacity charge line | $3105.60 |
| rebill credit dated to that cycle | minus $612.08 |
| monthly supply rate | $43706.00 |
| termination notice days of the structure | 30 |
| supply portion: 43706.00 multiplied by 30, divided by 30 | $43706.00 |
| requirement: 18640.25 plus 43706.00 | $62346.25 |
| deposits posted on the contract | $45000.00 |
| deposits refunded on the contract | $0.00 |
| amount remitted: 62346.25 less 45000.00 | $17346.25 |

With deposits held of $70000.00 instead, the deposits already cover the requirement of $62346.25, and nothing is remitted.

## Basis questions

- *Which fee forms the damages portion?* The early termination fee line billed on this contract, at its full billed amount.
- *Are deposits on the business's other contracts deducted?* No. Only the deposits held on this contract are deducted.
- *When is anything rounded?* Once, at the amount remitted, half up to the cent.
